title: AstraZit Radio Profile Schema
description: Radio projection profile consumed by AstraZit Radio (Application #1) for rotation, daypart curation, and broadcast metadata.

radio_eligible.description: Master gate determining whether track can enter live radio playout selection.

eligibility_status.description: Detailed curation status for broadcast clearance.

rotation_tier.description: Opaque tier key from a future human-approved station programming profile; no vocabulary is established by OS-003.

daypart_candidates.description: Keys from a future approved station daypart profile; OS-003 defines no schedule or daypart vocabulary.

energy_rating.description: Broadcast energy level from 0.0 (calm/ambient) to 1.0 (peak intensity).

intro_duration_seconds.description: Duration in seconds before vocals or primary melody starts (for DJ/voiceover ducks).

outro_duration_seconds.description: Duration in seconds of outro fade/tail for smooth crossfading.

programming_notes.description: Curator commentary, transition suggestions, or special programming context.
